newsitem.title: USA: AT&T to start Illinois local phone service.
newsitem.headline: AT&T to start Illinois local phone service.

text.p: AT&T Corp said Wednesday it filed a tariff with the Illinois Commerce Commission to begin providing local telephone service to Illinois residential customers.
AT&T said it will begin service Thursday in Libertyville and Waukegan.

The number of orders from the two areas will be limited until the company is certain it can handle a larger volume of orders meeting customers' high expectations, AT&T said. At that time, it will take orders from residential customers throughout the state.
AT&T said it will initially resell Ameritech Corp local phone service.
